sections.text:
-Target: 1 random enemy out of all enemies. Ability Power 610. Success value 100. 10x physical damage (Star).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies (NPCs). Decreases action speed by 60 for 120 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Cost recovery speed reduced by 10 for 120 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Activates Time Slice which reduces the time advantageous effects (buffs, special buffs, and non-removable buffs) are applied to the target by 60 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Changes Cost held to 50. [Demerit]
-Target: yourself. Applies Redoubt for 120 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; [Special] reduces physical/magic damage by 50%; nullifies fixed damage; nullifies special status ailments; nullifies status ailments. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
-Applies Anguish Collapse (Ability Power decreases by 50 when attacking an enemy not in Break, applies Grief with a 10% to chance to increase damage received by 50%, disables Unison gauge filling effects) to the enemy Field for 60 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 20000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 20000
